## Verdict: the link is already there — nothing to add

I traced both touchpoints before changing anything, and the Calendar entry already exists in the working tree **and** in the running build:

| Touchpoint | Where | State |
|---|---|---|
| `@AppsSection` (desktop sidebar "APPS" launcher) | `client/src/components/layout/AppsSection.vue` — `NavItem` `fa-regular fa-calendar-days` / "Calendar" (right after Planning, always visible) → `handleNavigateToCalendar()` → `openApp('calendar')` | ✅ present |
| Mobile apps (More sheet launcher) | `client/src/config/mobile.js` — `MOBILE_APP_GROUPS` → group **Work**: `key: 'calendar'`, "Agenda, events and reminders", tone `warning`; plus `MOBILE_ROUTE_TITLES.calendar` | ✅ present |
| App registry / wiring | `client/src/config/apps.js` → `calendar` (route `{ name: 'calendar' }`) · `client/src/config/appComponentsMap.js` → `views/CalendarView.vue` · `client/src/router/index.ts` → `/:projectName/calendar` | ✅ present |

Runtime evidence (not just source): the deployed bundle served by the `codx-junior-client` container already contains both entries —

```
$ grep -o 'label:"Calendar"'                          dist/assets/index-*.js  → label:"Calendar"
$ grep -o "Agenda, events and reminders"              dist/assets/index-*.js  → Agenda, events and reminders
$ ls dist/assets | grep CalendarView                  → CalendarView-DZhhYsJj.js
$ grep -c "/:projectName/calendar"                    → 1
```

So clicking "Calendar" opens the dockview panel in desktop mode and `/:projectName/calendar` in single/mobile mode, and it is searchable in the mobile launcher ("calendar"). It landed together with the calendar M0 UI work (`m0-ui-calendarview-grids-sidebar-project-filter-store-and-wiring`), so this Backlog card is effectively already implemented — duplicating the entries would create two "Calendar" items.

**One real inconsistency I did find** (not requested, so I did not touch it): the desktop *Windows* menu list in `client/src/components/main-menu/WindowsMenuItems.vue` has Management, Harness, Planning, Wiki… but **no Calendar**.

Want me to:
1. add `{ label: 'Calendar', icon: 'fa-regular fa-calendar-days', action: 'calendar' }` (+ its handler `calendar: () => this.$ui.openApp('calendar')`) to the Windows menu for parity, and/or
2. move this card (`calendar.2241f4a6…`, board `codx-junior maintenance`) from **Backlog → Done**?
